scope: Cancellation after ZIP completion and before export job publication, temporary-file cleanup, quota recovery and HTTP disconnect/retry/download/release

before.reproduction: Ran the new tests directly against the pre-fix service, without reverting prior changes. All 3 reproduced failures.

skipReason: Node/Rust archive interoperability requires VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; native archive code unchanged
testEnvironment: Temporary registered workspaces in isolated child processes run the actual export service, ZIP writer and HTTP router. A controlled fs.stat pause after completed ZIP output fixes the late-cancellation boundary without timing or large-file assumptions. Document and workspace exports each cancel 3 times, then fill all 3 slots; a fourth unclaimed job remains protected by quota. A real HTTP abort confirms immediate cleanup followed by regeneration, byte-exact download, release and 410. Authored source, templates, metadata, assets and manifest bytes stay identical. Existing export/dialog/request tests also ran.
